ns2:course.label: Component Design
ns2:course.description: Design of basic engineering components: structural members, machine parts, and connections. Principles applied include: material failure (yield, fracture, fatigue); buckling and other instabilities; design reliability; analytical simulation. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: GE 311 and GE 320.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: No graduate credit. Prerequisite: GE 311 and GE 320.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Engineering or Graduate College.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is an approved Design Elective in the GE Undergraduate curriculum.
